N-4.1-A.skill: interpret the derivative of a rate function in context, with units and sign, without confusing the rate with its own rate of change.

N-4.1-B.skill: estimate a derivative from a table with a symmetric difference quotient and interpret it as a rate with units, not as an average per-unit value.

N-4.2-A.skill: decide when a particle is speeding up by comparing the signs of velocity and acceleration, not either sign alone.

N-4.2-B.skill: distinguish total distance traveled from displacement and final position when velocity changes sign.

N-4.3-A.skill: combine marginal revenue and marginal cost into a marginal profit and read the sign of the second derivative as the trend of that rate.

N-4.3-B.skill: differentiate a rational or exponential model, with units, and compare the instantaneous rate to an average rate over an interval.

N-4.4-A.skill: relate a changing hypotenuse to a changing leg by differentiating the Pythagorean relationship before substituting values.

N-4.4-B.skill: set up the volume relationship for a cone or trough using the stated shape constraint, so that only one variable changes before differentiating.

N-4.5-A.skill: solve a related-rates problem involving an angle or similar triangles by differentiating the trigonometric or proportional relationship.

N-4.5-B.skill: apply the product rule to a quantity that depends on two changing variables, keeping the sign of each rate.

N-4.6-A.skill: use a tangent-line approximation at the correct point and decide whether it overestimates or underestimates from the concavity of the function.

N-4.6-B.skill: use a tangent-line model in reverse to estimate when a target value is reached, and use concavity to decide whether the true time is earlier or later.

N-4.7-A.skill: decide whether L'Hôpital's rule applies, then apply it correctly, including repeated applications and chain-rule factors.

N-4.7-B.skill: rewrite a 0·∞ or 1^∞ form with a logarithm or a quotient so that L'Hôpital's rule can be used, then evaluate the limit.
